profile.headline: Software Engineer I | Computer Science
profile.summary:
The fusion of analytical chemistry and computer science underpins my professional journey, culminating in a role as Software Engineer at Smartsheet. My tenure at Smartsheet, starting as an intern and now as a full-time engineer, has been marked by leveraging project management skills to enhance software solutions and streamline operations. 

With a strong foundation in both the sciences and technology, I bridge the gap between complex data analysis and innovative engineering. My bilingual proficiency supports seamless communication with diverse teams, ensuring that my contributions are not only technical but also foster collaborative growth.

positions.title: Gas Chromatograph Mass Spectrometer Analyst
positions.description:
-Create Standard Operating Procedures
-Operationalized a fully functioning and accredited Analytical Chemistry laboratory
Research
-Develop, and implement methods to streamline the company’s productivity 
-Effectively communicate with a wide range of stakeholders from auditors to corporate partners.
-Contact vendors to procure chemicals and other products

positions.title: Senior Resident Assistant
positions.description:
Advised students in the residence hall, provided personal, interpersonal and academic assistance to residents while providing a cohesive and inclusive living and learning environment in the hall.

- Responsible for being in charge of the hall when Resident Director is on leave
- Maintained office hours to perform administrative tasks such as program tracking, dorm budget, answering phone calls, answering questions from residents and fellow RAs, and assisting residents with room changes. 
- Run bi-weekly Desk Attendant (DA) meetings
- Worked closely with the Resident Director on independent tasks 
- Promote the development of the residential community
- Co-Interview and train desk attendants 
- Build DAs work schedule 
- Run staff meetings to discuss upcoming events, community concerns

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description:
As a Resident Assistant (RA), I facilitate the social, academic, and personal adjustment of students to the residence hall and University; while developing a sense of community among residents as members of a floor, residents of a hall, and active participants in the residence life system.

- Enforced Residence Life Policy according to the current student handbook 
- Built and maintained a positive, healthy community 
- Collaborated with study abroad offices and on-campus organizations to provide resources for students
- Conducted floor meetings to inform students about policies, upcoming dates, and check out procedures
- Received outstanding performance reviews in areas of communication, organization, and community
development
- Planned, budgeted, organized, and held educational and social programs for the residents twice a month
- Obtained training on suicidal ideation and awareness

positions.title: Office Supervisor
positions.description:
- Maintained department functionality through use of spreadsheets, paper records, and excellent         communication
- Manage Office Communications
- Monitor business email accounts
- Assist marketing management 
-  People management
- Maintain calendar
- Prepare correspondence, reports, and agendas
- Perform research projects
